park-city.style: True A-frame cabin (built 1965) on 0.57 acres in the gated Pine Mountain community, backing directly to National Forest. Existing wraparound deck on two sides.
park-city.hotTub: Set it on the side deck facing the trees — already framed, level, and shaded from the afternoon sun.
park-city.distance: ~21 mi (35 min) from this region's highest-revenue Old Town / Deer Valley cluster — the trade-off for a genuine A-frame this far under budget.
